Class FitnessGoal

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.model.FitnessGoal
public final class FitnessGoal extends Object
One user's fitness goal: what they are working toward, by when, and whether they got there.

The class is immutable. Completing a goal returns a new instance via achievedOn(LocalDate) rather than mutating this one, so a goal can never be half-updated and every field can stay final.

All the rules about a goal live here rather than in the screen that draws it: whether the target has been reached, how long is left, and how early or late it was completed. Date-dependent methods take today as a parameter instead of calling LocalDate.now(), which is what makes them testable.

US-12 — Set a fitness goal. US-13 — Track goal progress. US-14 — Mark a goal achieved.
